confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live booking pages or listings were inspected. Victoria Falls prices are often quoted in USD with a dual-currency local market, which adds volatility. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and hotel_3star_2p is the least certain. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer using the local price relationship because direct knowledge is weak. The FX observation comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page and was not verified against the page contents directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southern African tourist towns that serve visitors to major falls and safari gateways, such as Livingstone (Zambia) and Kasane (Botswana), adjusted for Zimbabwe's tourist-facing USD pricing. The July 2026 window is in the high tourist season, so accommodation anchors reflect in-season rates with taxes and mandatory fees included.
